entities.name: Pedro Asúa Mendía
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pedro Asúa Mendía was a Spanish Roman Catholic priest and engineer. He studied under the Jesuits and he trained also as an architect. He graduated in that field in 1915. He worked on schools and houses for religious across Spain where he served as a priest. He was killed in hatred of his faith during the Spanish Civil War.
